name: RealityCheck-Timer
summary:
RealityCheck is a powerful and easy-to-use interval timer for focused work, training, and workouts – especially in immersive environments like VR.

In VR, it’s easy to lose track of time – RealityCheck helps you stay in control of your sessions and reminds you exactly when it matters.

Create custom intervals or use flexible countdown timers to structure your routines and stay in the flow without distractions. With saved plans, you can quickly access and reuse your routines anytime.
